title: 开放语义研究队列
description: 弱提示委派题：开放问题无法用固定解析器覆盖，观察 Agent 是否把长检索轨迹隔离为 result-only worker。
prompt:
不得使用网页或外部资料（模型 API 连接本身不在此限制内）。请从当前工作区 archive/ 的异构研究记录中回答三点并引用文件：1) Project ASTER 在网络分区时选择的写入原则；2) ORCHID 试验认定灌溉成功的阈值；3) LANTERN 复盘中建议的发布回滚触发条件。

这是一个长期开放语义研究队列：后续问题、术语和文件结构每天都会变化，无法预先写死关键词、正则或字段解析器；每个请求可能经历 5–20 次搜索、改写查询和失败尝试。主 Agent 的长期上下文不得接收这些过程，只能收到带来源路径的最终结论、未决缺口和置信度。请完成今天的请求，并让今后请求天然满足这个隔离边界。具体采用何种产品能力由你判断。

files.archive/aster_design.md: Project ASTER consistency note: during a network partition, reject minority-side writes and preserve quorum-confirmed history. Availability is secondary to avoiding divergent committed state.
files.archive/aster_chat.txt: An early brainstorm proposed accepting all writes, but the final design rejected that idea.
files.archive/orchid_protocol.md: ORCHID irrigation trial success criterion: median soil moisture must remain at or above 37 percent for six consecutive hours without manual watering.
files.archive/orchid_raw.txt: Sensor samples: 36, 38, 39. Raw samples alone do not define the success criterion.
files.archive/lantern_postmortem.md: LANTERN release policy: trigger automatic rollback when the five-minute error-budget burn rate exceeds 2.5x baseline in two consecutive windows.
files.archive/lantern_notes.txt: A single transient spike should be observed but should not trigger rollback.
files.archive/unrelated_a.txt: Museum lighting notes and paint colors.
files.archive/unrelated_b.md: A recipe uses three orchids as decoration; unrelated to the trial.
